text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — our hit-depth and tokens_saved panels show a correlated drop starting ~02:12 UTC after the kernel-selector change last night. per-model and per-route lanes look affected (m-ggml-13b, /chat). screenshot: https://grafana.internal/r/XYZ

infra-bot: deploy finished: infra-service@prod commit abc123def by Alex at 2024-11-22T02:10:34Z :white_check_mark:

Mike: on it, pulling graphs now. which tenant slices are worst?

Yana: looks like a ramp in KV cache misses for medium-length prompts. can you paste the query for the tokens_saved waterfall?

Nora: query I used to generate the waterfall (grafana Loki/PromQL equivalent):
```
sum by (tenant, model, route) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[7d]))
/
sum by (tenant, model, route) (increase(tokens_consumed_total[7d]))
```
This gives a tokens_saved ratio by tenant/model/route.

Dennis: profiler notes: after the kernel change, key normalization code path executed ~1.8x more often for the same request mix. Miss rate for the KV cache for m-ggml-13b jumped from 12% -> 34% on canary hosts. The hot-spot looks to be in the key hashing branch when batch-folding is enabled > 256.

Alex: i rolled kernel-selector to prefer fused-v2 for short sequences (<1024) to improve throughput. I didn't expect normalization side effects — we changed a small normalization order to make fused kernels safe.

Priya: we need to treat this as a perf regression with customer impact. acme-inc and beta-corp show biggest token cost increases (per-customer token_saved drop: 78% -> 41% week-over-week).

Sam: Acme CSM pinged us — they've seen a 20% increase in per-request token counts and billing spikes. Can we provide them a mitigation plan quick?

Mike: short-term mitigation: route /chat for critical tenants to kernel-fallback=legacy via runtime-routing config. CLI snippet to push a fallback: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --route "/chat" --kernel-preference "legacy" --override-tenant acme-inc,beta-corp --reason "kv miss regression"
```
That should force older key path until we fix normalization.

Yana: also adding an alert: if tokens_saved ratio drops >15% vs baseline for top 10 tenants, page eng-runtime. Nora, can you add the dashboard panels we need?

Nora: adding these panels now:
- per-tenant tokens_saved_ratio (7d sliding)
- kernel_selector_ratio by host/model/route
- kv_miss_rate aggregated by tenant/model
- hit_depth CDF for first-token vs prefix length
I'll tag owners and add an explainer note.

Alex: i'm going to push a canary rollback of the kernel selector patch to a small host pool and re-run the profiler. deploying rollback: infra patch id patch-4812.

infra-bot: rollout started: rollback patch-4812 -> hosts {canary-1..4} at 2024-11-22T02:45:12Z

Dennis: when the rollback hits, i'll re-run the key-path flamegraph and diff the hash branch counts. Expect to have numbers in ~15m.

Priya: action items: Alex -> rollback + quick postmortem of normalization change; Dennis -> flamegraphs and missing-key distribution; Nora -> new panels + alert; Mike/Yana -> apply routing fallback for top tenants until rollback proves stable; Sam -> notify Acme with mitigation note. I'll coordinate follow-up with a short postmortem thread once we have flamegraphs. :thumbsup:

Mike: ack, applying routing overrides now.

Sam: i'll draft the customer note and share for review.

Nora: alert created (ID: alert-7721). will attach screenshots to the incident ticket.

Priya: thanks all — keep updates here. if rollback doesn't recover tokens_saved within 30m, escalate to rollback all hosts.
